findings.title: self-heal-pipeline.md drafter idempotency claim is logically inverted relative to the drafter contract
findings.description: The DRAFT→ACCEPTED workflow section states the drafter does NOT re-draft after acceptance 'because the file is gone from .audits/proposed-rules/' — but per the drafter contract, absence of the file is exactly what triggers re-drafting (skip fires only when the file is present). The claim is logically inverted. The follow-on 'force a re-draft by deleting from ~/.claude/rules/' implies the drafter checks ~/.claude/rules/, but that check is absent from the drafter contract. Requires Sebastian to confirm intent: (a) add ~/.claude/rules/ check to drafter contract, or (b) correct the idempotency claim to say the drafter WILL re-draft after acceptance.
